sections.h2: What Is Node JS Used For?

paragraphs.html: Node.js is an open-source runtime, first released in 2009, that runs JavaScript outside the browser. Businesses use it for APIs that power mobile and web apps, live chat and notifications, data streaming, and backends that handle many users at once. In the 2025 Stack Overflow Developer Survey, Node.js was the most used web technology, reported by about 49% of developers.

paragraphs.text: Its strength is handling many simultaneous connections without waiting on slow tasks, thanks to an event-driven architecture. While one request waits for a database, Node.js keeps serving others.

sections.h2: What Node.js Development Services Does Teknoppy Offer?

items.title: Node JS Backend Development
items.text: Node JS backend development covers the server, database and business rules behind your product. Custom Node JS development Kochi companies order from us usually powers a mobile app, a customer platform or an internal system that has outgrown spreadsheets.

items.title: Node JS REST API Development and GraphQL
items.text: Node JS REST API development gives your apps and partners a secure, documented way to read and update data. Where clients need flexible queries, GraphQL API development lets each app request exactly the data it needs in one call, which reduces loading time on mobile networks.

items.title: Real-Time App Development
items.text: Real-time app development covers features that update instantly without refreshing the page: live order status, driver tracking, notifications and shared editing. WebSocket application development keeps a constant connection between the browser and the server, so updates arrive in milliseconds. Node JS chat application development uses the same approach for customer support chat, team messaging and in-app conversations.

items.title: Frameworks: Express and NestJS
items.text: Express JS development suits lean APIs and services that need to launch quickly. NestJS development suits larger systems that need strict structure, built-in testing and clear modules, which helps when several developers work on the same codebase. We choose between the two during discovery, based on the size of your system and how fast it needs to grow.

items.title: Node JS Microservices Development
items.text: Node JS microservices development splits a large system into small services, such as payments, notifications and reporting, that can be updated and scaled separately. We recommend microservices only when a system is large enough to benefit, because they add operating cost.

paragraphs.html: Typical projects include backends for delivery and service apps, live order and job tracking for logistics teams, notification services that send WhatsApp, SMS and email updates, and APIs that connect a company's website, mobile app and accounting software. Many clients start with one service and add more as their product grows.

paragraphs.text: How scalable is Node JS? Very, when the system is designed for it. A single Node.js server handles thousands of open connections, and more servers can be added behind a load balancer as traffic grows. Node JS serverless functions go further by running code only when a request arrives, so you pay for actual use rather than idle servers.
Node JS performance optimization covers database queries, caching, background jobs and memory use. Most slow Node.js systems we review can be made noticeably faster without a full rebuild.
We write every project using Node JS with TypeScript. Types catch errors while the code is written, document how data flows, and make the project easier for any future developer to maintain.

sections.h2: Node JS vs Python for Backend and Node JS vs Go for APIs

paragraphs.text: Node JS vs Python for backend: Node.js excels at many simultaneous connections and real-time features, and lets one team use JavaScript across front end and back end. Python is the stronger choice when the system revolves around data science or machine learning.

Node JS vs Go for APIs: Go compiles to very fast programs and suits heavy computing tasks. Node.js has a much larger library ecosystem and hiring pool, which usually means faster delivery and lower cost for business APIs.

sections.h2: How Much Does Node JS Development Cost in India?

paragraphs.text: How much does Node JS development cost in India? It depends on the number of features, integrations, expected traffic and whether real-time functions are needed.
Projects are quoted per scope after discovery. Every quote from our Node JS development company Kochi office is fixed for the agreed scope and lists exactly what is included.

items.q: Why choose Node JS for backend?
items.a: Node.js handles many users at once, suits real-time features and uses JavaScript, the same language as most front ends. That means one team can work across the whole product, and features move from idea to release faster.

items.q: Is Node JS good for large applications?
items.a: Yes. Node.js supports large applications when they are structured well, using frameworks such as NestJS, TypeScript, automated tests and a clear service design. Many large platforms run their APIs on Node.js.

items.q: How long does a Node.js project take?
items.a: A focused API usually takes 4 to 6 weeks. Real-time features take 8 to 12 weeks, and larger platforms take 12 to 16 weeks. We confirm your timeline in writing after discovery.

items.q: Can Teknoppy take over an existing Node.js project?
items.a: Yes. We begin with a code and security audit, share a written report, fix urgent issues first and then plan improvements. Your system keeps running throughout the handover.
